Before you ask.
It reads the answer just given against the role's requirements and asks the follow-up a recruiter would scope, ownership, or a specific example instead of the next question on a fixed list.
Yes. You set the topics, the maximum number of follow-ups and the questions that must always be asked. Anything off-topic or non-compliant is blocked before it reaches a candidate.
In practice it's shorter. Irrelevant questions are skipped, so median completion time drops even though the answers carry more detail.
Yes for the major platforms Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, SmartRecruiters, iCIMS, Ashby and others through native sync or API. Anything custom is handled with a webhook or scheduled sync.
Data stays inside your account and is never used to train models outside it. Xobin is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified, with GDPR-aligned data processing and configurable retention.
Setup time depends on configuration, integrations and internal approvals. Confirm a rollout plan with our team for your workflow.
